# Doremi Road: code map

around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A piano-learning game: play notes, chords and progressions on a MIDI keyboard, computer keys or touch screen, train your ear and conquer the Realm of Harmony.
**Live:** https://doremiroad.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/doremiroad · **Layout:** JavaScript pages + tools/deploy.py (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/doremiroad/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- Edit the **project source in this folder**; GitHub only holds the built output (`tools/deploy.py` builds
  `theme/assets/app.js`/`app.css` from `web/`). Never edit `tools/.anvil-repo`.
- **New page**: `web/pages/<name>.html` with `UI.page('<name>', {title, auth, nav}, mount)`. Shared engines: `web/pages/_*.html`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code/<Module>.py`; call it from a page with `UI.api('name', {...})`.
- **New table/column**: `TABLES` in `tools/sync_to_anvil.py` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert after deploy).
- **Header, footer, tab bar**: `web/app.js`. Shared helpers: `web/core.js` (`window.UI`). Tokens + components: `web/core.css`.
- **Check**: `python -I tools/check.py --ui` → ALL CHECKS PASSED. Look: `tools/preview/devserver.py` + `tools/preview/shots.py`.
- **Deploy**: `python tools/deploy.py` (dry run), then `python tools/deploy.py --push "Message"`.
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py doremiroad` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`tools/sync_to_anvil.py` TABLES)

- **users**: display_name:str, is_admin:bool, progress:obj, last_played:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin
- **territories**: key:str, name:str, emoji:str, blurb:str, color:str, x:num, y:num, position:num, published:bool · used in Admin, Game
- **levels**: key:str, territory→territories, name:str, position:num, data:obj, published:bool, updated:dt, builtin:bool, clears:num · used in Admin, Game
- **scores**: user→users, level→levels, score:num, accuracy:num, stars:num, at:dt · used in Admin, Game
